notes.title: Version 1.2 released
notes.content:
hey guys, based on community feedback (thanks MrUnbecoming & marsuke) we made a few tweaks to the game. 

changes in this version:
- added feature to toggle soundfx via pause menu
- fixed a critical bug that would prevent the player from completing level 1-10
- smaller bugfixes
